messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: Shinyapps authentication
parts:
Hello Subhash,
To answer your first question, you can absolutely build applications similar to the one described by that article with the Standard plan.  

On your second question, I am a little unclear on what the ask is.  With the Standard plan you can invite users to access one or more of your applications.  They would use the same auth information for their user account to access any of the applications you make available to them. If the question is whether you could have just one username/password for all your applications, the answer is that shinyapps.io's auth does require an end user.  

Hope this answers the question.
-Tareef

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: Shinyapps authentication
parts:
Unfortunately we haven't implemented trials as an option yet.  
Just to be clear, if you want one application that is private, and another that is public you would need to have two different applications.
For the public application you can use the free plan to see how the application would work.  The only features that are not available in the free plan over the Standard plan are additional memory options, and private authentication.
